timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, I'm Frank Sardinan and I represent Section D as a one-ill student. I'm running for your student body senate.
And I'm running on three main platforms. Integrity, transparency and accountability. It matters who you elect to represent you.
And believe me, I'm trustworthy and responsible and you will not regret voting for me. Transparency is key. You need to know where your money is being sent.
Spent. And I can ensure if elected that you'll know where every dollar is going. And accountability. This needs to be a two-way conversation.
So please do not hesitate in the next couple weeks to come up to me and voice your ideas. If elected, I promise I'll represent you. I'm the best way possible.
So remember, next Monday and Tuesday, October 3rd and 4th, Sardinan for senate vote for me. Thanks.
